name: Zachary Schmidt
bio: I'm a physicist-turned-entrepreneur, I lead efforts that leverage actuarial-grade cyber and AI risk quantification platforms to translate chaos into financial clarity. I also serve as Executive Chairman and CEO of GoTeneo.AI, focused on Corporate National Security, an emerging discipline where private enterprise meets national defense front lines. A Physics graduate from Longwood University, I built my career on the ground floor of cyber program building: From Check Point's first New-Hire Program, to scaling a $10M book of business, to driving channel transformation, to managing major accounts at Proofpoint, and then leading expansion as VP of Sales at RedTrace Technologies.
